conditions.displayName: any actor crash in the workshop atespace in 15m

documentation.content: An actor moved to CRASHED — its live execution is lost; `kubectl ate revert actor` brings it back to SUSPENDED from its last snapshot (see `docs/metrics/registry/metrics.yaml`'s `ate.actor.crashes` entry in the substrate checkout). Find which one and why: filter Cloud Logging on `resource.labels.namespace_name="ate-system"` and `"Actor state changed"` with `labels."ate.atespace"="workshop"`, read `status.crash.message` on `kubectl ate get actor <name> -a workshop -o yaml`, then revert or delete it once you've captured what you need.
